# bayarea-pulse

Sites template; Crawl-delay: 30; /jsonapi/node/hs_event is 404).

- The SLAC Photon Science Seminar Series is published here now (the SSRL page says so);

- `events-all-rss-*.xml`: 3 items; `<description>` holds the speaker's affiliation,
